title: 3BR Rosemary Beach Home with a Private Courtyard & Pool
meta_description: Stay at Captain Jack Cottage, a 3BR, 2.5BA Rosemary Beach home near the beach, with a private heated pool, open floor plan, and a porch. Sleeps 7.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Captain Jack Cottage
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionCaptain Jack Cottage, formerly known as Soul del Sol, is located near the RB racquet club and fitness center. Captain Jack Cottage was recently updated and refreshed in the Winter of 2022 is an ideal option featuring a private pool, an open second story floor plan as well as intimate spaces nestled throughout.Native scrub oaks frame the cottage private back courtyard and pool area that lead to the first floor accommodations. The master bedroom features a private bath, flat screen TV, Queen bed and direct access to a comfortable screened in porch. Other accommodations include a guest bedroom with Queen bed and a fun bunk room, both with their own flat screen TVs and access to a second full bathroom.The open floor plan of the upstairs area is optimal for entertaining and includes a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, dining area accommodating six, and an entertainment area housing an oversized flat screen TV which can be enjoyed by all while cooking, dining, or just relaxing. Adjacent to the large main area is a quaint writing nook and spiral staircase that leads up to a cupola with two built in twin beds/seating perfect for some memorable late night story swapping and laughing.While not enjoying your own private pool, meander along the oak shaded wooden boardwalk just outside the front door which leads to delectable restaurants, boutiques, beaches and nearby Triangle Park perfect for daydreaming on a bench or catching up on your favorite novel.HOME HIGHLIGHTS:• Private Heated Pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)• 4 Minute Walk to Beach Walkover F or E• Easy Boardwalk Access to Eastern Long Green Park• Newly Upgraded Audio/Video with 55" OLED LG Smart 4K TV• Apple TV, Logitech Elite All-In-One Remote & Sonos Sound System• Several Balconies & Porches• Charming Cupola with Seating, a TV, and views of Rosemary Beach• 1 Minute walk to Sky PoolHOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 9, Max occupancy 7)FIRST FLOOR• Master Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Tub. (Sleeps 2)• Guest Room: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only (Sleeps 2)• Guest Room: Bunk Room - Triple Bunks with Twin Over Twin Over Twin Beds - Shared Bathroom with Shower Only (Sleeps 3)SECOND FLOOR• Kitchen and Living Area• Dining Area with Seating for 6• Half Bath Off the Living RoomTHIRD FLOOR• Cupola - Covered Lounge Space with two custom Twin beds (Sleeps 2)AMENITIES INCLUDED:• High-Speed Mesh Network WIFI• 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes• Access to Rosemary Beach Fitness Center and Tennis Courts (Additional Cost)• Access to the 4 Community Pools in Rosemary Beach• Amenity Passes, Codes for Beach Walkovers and Beach Service Provided
